name: pandemic_spike_start
description: when a post-pandemic-style price spike begins: anywhere from 2031 (after normalization_start) to 2064, so a scenario ending before 2064 has no episode in some members; override it by name to place the episode

name: pandemic_spike_end
description: when the spike ends: 2 to 4 years after it begins (2021-2023 ran 3)
